nintendoNotes:
Official Nintendo AU lists Persona 5 Strikers as a Nintendo Switch title compatible with Nintendo Switch 2, 11.9 GB, one local player, TV/Tabletop/Handheld modes, and Save Data Cloud. The western Nintendo AU language list is French, German, Italian, Spanish and English.

Supplier selection supplied by user is Traditional Chinese. Because the western Nintendo listing does not show Chinese, the file preserves this as a supplier regional/SKU language and does not overwrite the western official language list.

Supplier variants: Regular / 普通版 ¥6.8 (pre-discount ¥10); Standard / 标准版 ¥26.4 (pre-discount ¥30). Costs: Regular 1,250 IQD; Standard 5,750 IQD. Only two supplier variants exist, so no DLC product types are created even though the game has real official DLC metadata.

Substantially faster loading in measured tests
No native Switch 2 enhancement / no 60 fps patch

gameplayPillars.title: Hybrid Persona Action
gameplayPillars.description: Fight crowds in real time while still exploiting Persona elemental weaknesses, buffs, debuffs and technical effects.

gameplayPillars.title: Control the Phantom Thieves
gameplayPillars.description: Switch directly among Phantom Thieves, each with unique weapons, Master Arts and combat roles.

gameplayPillars.title: Road Trip Across Japan
gameplayPillars.description: Travel across Japanese cities, investigate local corruption and infiltrate themed Jails.

gameplayPillars.title: Build BOND Skills
gameplayPillars.description: Earn BOND points across exploration, requests and combat to unlock party-wide bonuses and customize progression.

worldSummary: The Phantom Thieves travel across Japan, where distorted Jails are manipulating people’s desires. Each city becomes a new investigation, mixing road-trip downtime with infiltration and combat.

storyChapters.title: The Summer Reunion
storyChapters.body: The Phantom Thieves reunite for a summer vacation but discover that a new Metaverse-like crisis is spreading through Japan.

storyChapters.title: Jails Across Japan
storyChapters.body: As the group travels from city to city, they investigate Monarchs whose Jails manipulate the desires of ordinary people.

storyChapters.title: The Source of the Crisis
storyChapters.body: New allies and deeper revelations connect the individual cases to a broader threat affecting society.

storyChapters.title: The Road Trip Finale
storyChapters.body: The Phantom Thieves trace the connected crises to their source and bring the nationwide road trip toward its final confrontation.

perfNotes: Switch targets 30 fps. Backward-compatibility testing on Switch 2 reports a much steadier 30 fps and significantly shorter loading. Approximate ~864p docked / ~648p handheld figures come from secondary technical reporting, so they are explicitly marked as reported rather than official Nintendo measurements.

handheld.resolution: up to 1080p TV-profile rendering with Handheld Mode Boost; 720p without Boost
handheld.outputResolution: 1920x1080 display output with Handheld Mode Boost
handheld.notes: Backward compatibility stabilizes the 30 fps target noticeably compared with original Switch in testing.

tv.resolution: up to 1080p dynamic, system-upscaled to 4K output
tv.notes: Backward-compatible 30 fps with improved consistency; no native higher-frame-rate patch.

devicePerformance.upscaling: System-level upscaling to 4K output in TV mode
devicePerformance.loadingNotes: RPG Site testing reports dashboard-to-game loading around 20–21 seconds on Switch 2 versus roughly 40–42 seconds on original Switch, and save-related loads around 7–8 seconds versus roughly 18–20 seconds.
devicePerformance.sourceName: RPG Site / Nitchigamer / Switch 2 Handheld Mode Boost testing
devicePerformance.performanceNotes: Backward compatibility materially improves frame-rate stability and loading. Before Handheld Mode Boost, Switch 2 handheld uses the fixed 720p profile. With Boost enabled it can use the higher TV-mode rendering profile. TV mode renders up to 1080p dynamically and the system can output an upscaled 4K signal; the game itself remains capped at 30 fps.

storageNotes: Nintendo AU lists an 11.9 GB file size.

dlc.name: Persona Legacy BGM
dlc.description: Official DLC adding legacy battle tracks from Persona 1, Persona 2, Persona 3 / Portable, and Persona 4 / Golden.

dlc.name: All-Out Attack Pack
dlc.description: Official item/skill pack containing boost skills, affinity support, armor, Persona points, enemy debuffs and ally buffs.

dlc.name: Digital Deluxe Bonus Content
dlc.description: The Digital Deluxe package includes bonus soundtrack, digital art book, behind-the-scenes video and the two gameplay DLC packs.

faq.q: Does Persona 5 Strikers support Traditional Chinese?
faq.a: The supplier listing supplied by the user says Traditional Chinese. Nintendo AU’s western page does not list Chinese, so Chinese support is treated as region/SKU-dependent rather than generalized to every copy.

faq.q: Does Persona 5 Strikers work on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists Switch 2 compatibility as supported, but it remains the Switch version via backward compatibility.
No. Nintendo lists one local player and the campaign is single-player.

faq.q: Why are there DLC metadata fields but no DLC product type?
faq.a: Official Nintendo lists real DLC for Persona 5 Strikers, so the informational DLC section is populated. The supplier data, however, has only two variants (Regular and Standard), so under the store rule there are only Standard Offline and Standard Online product types.
